title: Roasted Asparagus with American Cheese
description: A simple and delicious side dish featuring roasted asparagus topped with melted American cheese.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or a silicone mat.
Toss the asparagus with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Spread the asparagus out in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet.
Roast in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes, or until tender.
While the asparagus is roasting, place the American cheese in a skillet over medium heat.
Cook, stirring occasionally, until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the asparagus from the oven and top with the melted cheese.
Return the asparagus to the oven and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, or until the cheese is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and serve hot.
